records.cite: doc 01 Joining and leaving > Welcome back (D-049); CEO asked for up to 50; one picked at random per rejoin, shown only to the rejoiner
lines: Haha, you crashed.
Welcome back. The farm didn't miss you.
Your PC took one look at the corn and gave up.
Crashed? The creature didn't even have to try.
Even your computer was too scared to stay.
Your farmer stood there drooling the whole time.
The crows saw everything.
Skill issue. Hardware edition.
Back from the dead, the boring way.
Your teammates have already made fun of you. Now it's official.
Most people die to the creature. You died to Windows.
The bank noticed. The bank always notices.
Your crops didn't water themselves while you were gone.
The scarecrow moved. You didn't.
Somebody has to explain this at the Dawn Report.
You left so fast the corn is still swaying.
Even the Prize Pumpkin held it together better than you.
Your lantern blew out. So did your game.
The creature wanted to lure you. It got bored waiting.
That wasn't a jumpscare. That was your graphics card.
Your ghost has been standing in the barn this whole time.
Bear traps hold you for seconds. Your PC held you for minutes.
New Season Award unlocked: Least Reliable Farmhand.
Everyone heard you yell. That was not the creature.
The generator stayed on longer than you did.
You crashed harder than the cart on the Harvest Moon.
Corruption spreads. So, apparently, does your bad luck.
Did you see it? No. You saw the desktop.
Your walkie went quiet. So did you. Suspicious.
The medical bill for this one is just embarrassment.
Some farmers fear the night. You fear the loading screen.
Welcome back. Please keep your game open this time.
The pegboard lists you as "missing".
You were the creature's easiest kill and it wasn't even there.
The moonflowers bloomed. You missed it. Obviously.
Rebooting is not a valid hiding strategy.
Your team voted. They wanted to leave you out there.
Crashing doesn't reset the debt. Nice try.
The corn whispered your name. Your PC panicked.
Even the bots stayed connected.
You were gone long enough for the crows to move in.
"Help me" was meant to be the creature's line, not yours.
Your farmer is fine. Your reputation is not.
First you crashed. Then the creature started using your voice.
Dropped items, dropped frames, dropped out.
Your hat was found by the corn edge. It's been handed in.
Somebody put a flag where you used to stand.
Back already? The funeral was just getting good.
Crashed again? The creature is taking notes.
Next time, just pretend you fell in a pit.
